## Abstract

This project examines how macroeconomic indicators predict US recessions over 1996–2020. We compare logistic regressions using principal components and predictors selected through variance-inflation analysis, assessing predictive performance with out-of-sample ROC curves. The analysis brings together financial, labour-market, and monetary indicators and considers the limitations of the data and modelling choices.

## Data and methods

The dataset is obtained through Kaggle and combines series from Yahoo, NBER, Quandl, and Macrotrends. The workflow covers exploratory analysis, scaling, dimension reduction, and model evaluation in Python.
